raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "have a booking at"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "hotel Ambasador"
  role location "Brașov"
  role time "next weekend"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "be included"
    role subject "breakfast"
    role object "the booking"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "require payment"
    role subject "breakfast"
    role object "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end
